title: On computing and the complexity of computing higher-order $U$-statistics, exactly
abstract: arXiv:2508.12627v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Higher-order $U$-statistics abound in fields such as statistics, machine learning, and computer science, but are known to be highly time-consuming to compute in practice. Despite their widespread appearance, a comprehensive study of their computational complexity is surprisingly lacking. This paper aims to fill this gap by presenting several results related to the computational aspect of $U$-statistics. First, we derive a useful decomposition from a $m$-th order $U$-statistic to a linear combination of $V$-statistics with orders not exceeding $m$, which are generally more feasible to compute. Second, we explore the connection between exactly computing $V$-statistics and Einstein summation, a tool often used in computational mathematics and quantum computing to accelerate tensor computations. translated_title: 关于高阶$U$-统计量的计算及其计算复杂度
translated_abstract: arXiv:2508.12627v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：高阶$U$-统计量在统计学、机器学习和计算机科学等领域中大量出现，但已知在实践中计算非常耗时。尽管它们广泛出现，但对其计算复杂度的全面研究却出奇地缺乏。本文旨在通过展示与$U$-统计量计算相关的若干结果来填补这一空白。首先，我们从一个$m$阶$U$-统计量推导出一种有用的分解，将其转化为阶数不超过$m$的$V$-统计量的线性组合，这些$V$-统计量通常更容易计算。其次，我们探讨了精确计算$V$-统计量与爱因斯坦求和（一种常用于计算数学和量子计算中加速张量计算的工具）之间的联系。第三，我们基于特定图的树宽，提供了精确计算$U$-统计量时间复杂度的乐观估计。
tldr: 本文首次系统研究了高阶$U$-统计量的计算复杂度，提出将其分解为低阶$V$-统计量的方法，并利用爱因斯坦求和和图树宽给出精确计算的时间复杂度估计。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies the computational complexity of higher-order $U$-statistics for the first time, proposing a decomposition into lower-order $V$-statistics and providing time complexity estimates via Einstein summation and graph treewidth.
